summary: Fixed the realistic live flashlight RT unsupported crash path by gating ray-traced spotlight shadow intent on confirmed hardware RT runtime CVar readback, and made the shadow intent helper bool-only so it no longer probes risky string/enum candidates through reflected calls.

Changed apply_spot_light_ray_traced_shadow_intent to use a conservative bool-only candidate strategy instead of string/enum probing.
Added regression coverage for unsupported RT readback, false/mismatched RT readback, confirmed RT readback, and bool-only reflected shadow intent candidates.

follow_up_recommendations: Inspector review should focus on the live RT readback gate and whether bool-only ray-traced shadow intent is conservative enough for supported hardware RT configurations.
memory_worthy: Realistic live flashlight now applies ray-traced spotlight shadow intent only when hardware RT runtime readback confirms the requested CVars; unsupported Vulkan SM5/RHI paths skip with logged state instead of probing reflected APIs.
Ray-traced spotlight shadow intent probing is now bool-only and no longer sends string/enum candidates such as Enabled through SPEAR reflected method/property calls.
